title: Handlebar Remote
tagline: A slim thumb controller between the grip and the switch cube, for the dash and your phone
summary: A slim control collar on the left handlebar, between the grip and the bike's switch cube, under your thumb: a 5-way joystick with a button either side of it. It works the Handlebar Dash over its own wiring (one of the dash's expansion slots) and a phone or anything else over Bluetooth, as a keyboard with media keys. The collar holds only the switches, sealed under a printed TPU keypad; a small box nearby holds the electronics. General purpose: the bar size, the gap and the angle are settings.
status: Designed and modelled (v1, checked in CAD, not printed or built yet). The switches and boards have no published drawings: measure yours first, and the gap you can make between the grip and the switch cube. The firmware comes next.
see_sub: A 19 mm collar in a 20 mm gap between the grip and the switch cube (slide the cube inboard to make it), its low pod facing your thumb; a small sealed box nearby for the electronics.

collar_top.name: Collar top
collar_top.what: The ring's upper half and the pod that holds the switch board (it rests on steps at the corners); 4 M2 inserts for the face plate, 2 M3 inserts for the collar's screws, the cable's hole on its inboard side
collar_top.material: ASA (PETG for a first try), 100% infill round the ring. On its side

collar_bottom.name: Collar bottom
collar_bottom.what: The ring's lower half: 2 M3 x 8 screws up into the top's inserts, a 1 mm rubber strip inside
collar_bottom.material: ASA / PETG, 100% infill. On its side

face_plate.name: Face plate
face_plate.what: Screws down on the keypad (4 M2 x 6 countersunk), squeezing it 0.2 mm: the joystick's hole and the 2 buttons' holes

keypad.name: Keypad
keypad.what: One TPU sheet on the pod's rim: the seal, the 2 hollow button domes (a nub under each presses its switch), and it hugs the joystick cap's sleeve

joy_cap.name: Joystick cap
joy_cap.what: A low 13 mm mushroom cap that pushes onto the 5-way switch's stem
joy_cap.material: ASA / PETG, or TPU for grip. Flat top down

box.name: Electronics box
box.what: The ESP32-C3 Super Mini and the CAN transceiver side by side; 2 cable holes at one end; 2 zip-tie slots underneath; 4 M2 inserts for the lid

box_lid.name: Box lid
box_lid.what: 4 M2 x 8 screws through the gasket into the box's corners

box_gasket.name: Box gasket
box_gasket.what: The walls' top and the 4 corner bosses, squeezed 0.2 mm by the lid

remote_assembled.name: Assembled
remote_assembled.what: The collar and the box on the bar, with stand-ins for the grip, the switch cube and the boards

params.name: gap_w
params.label: Gap between the grip and the switch cube
params.help: The collar is 1 mm narrower. Slide the switch cube inboard to make room.

params.name: pod_a
params.label: Where the controls face, round the bar
params.help: From straight forward: 90 = straight up, 125 = up and back toward your thumb.

params.name: nav_top
params.label: Joystick: the stem's top above its board
params.help: Too short and its cap can't grip it (the model says so).
